entries.content: Cross-document analysis completed: zero factual contradictions found between SCOUT artifacts (glossary, mental model, novelty catalogue, inter-process effectiveness, assumptions, boundaries, unknowns) and codebase verification. Agent count verified as exactly 42 across 7 tiers. Endocrine system confirmed active in BANZAI mode per squad-config. Key finding: 8 novel mechanisms identified with 3 ranked HIGH defensibility (NS-003, Endocrine, Constitutional Gate) but most are UNVALIDATED. Primary blocking unknowns: U-CA-004 (CA overlay gate), U-008 (NS-003 transfer to Echelon), U-003 (SAGE validation). Patent recommendation: File NS-003 immediately (novelty confirmed via systematic search, component proofs exist); defer 5 others pending efficacy validation. Echelon architecture is sound; production readiness blocked by unresolved experiments.

blocking_unknowns.impact: Blocking quality assurance; low-quality specs may pass gate

strengths: Contradiction detection early in pipeline (SYNTHESIZER phase) per PAT-002 (0.79 confidence); saves 20-30% downstream tokens
Multi-stage quality gates create redundancy; CODE-REVIEWER/TEST-GUARDIAN/SPEC-GUARD/VERIFICATION catch 30-50% of defects
Calibration injection empirically improves GATEKEEPER estimates (Spec 010 suggests 20%+ improvement, unvalidated)
Pattern registry shows strong evidence (PAT-001 through PAT-006: 0.79-0.88 confidence) that pipeline stages deliver value
bottlenecks: SAGE quality gate amendment loop adds 1-2 phases when spec fails (bottleneck: iterative refinement)
GATEKEEPER DEFER loop can repeat up to 3 times for ambiguous scope (rare but possible)
SAGE metric computation latency unknown; assumed <30 sec per spec
Specification explosion: 100k+ LOC may produce 1000+ requirements; SAGE gate throughput vs requirement count unknown
risks: Gate fatigue: multiple gates (SAGE + GATEKEEPER + CODE-REVIEWER + TEST-GUARDIAN + SPEC-GUARD + VERIFICATION) may slow development
SAGE gate validity unproven against human experts (no calibration); may be noisy
Contradiction scanner heuristics have unknown precision/recall (target ≥60% recall, but measured?)
